title.zh: 赌场管制（入场税变更）命令 2019
title.en: Casino Control (Variation of Entry Levies) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Casino Control (Variation of Entry Levies) Order 2019 and comes into operation on 4 April 2019.

2. The entry levies specified in section 116(1) of the Act are replaced, for the period starting on 4 April 2019 and ending on 3 April 2024, as follows:
(a)the entry levy under section 116(1)(a) of the Act is $150 for every consecutive period of 24 hours;
(b)the entry levy under section 116(1)(b) of the Act is $3,000 for an annual membership of the casino.
[S 440/2019 wef 18/06/2019]
